description: Defines an advanced data type for network ports, including port name/number mappings, translation functions, and filter translation logic for use within the Superset project.

classes.name: AdvancedDataType
classes.description: Represents a custom data type for network ports with translation and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: port_translation_func
methods.description: Converts port names or numbers in a request to a standardized response with port values.

methods.name: port_translate_filter_func
methods.description: Generates an SQLAlchemy filter expression based on the port column, operator, and values.
